name: awesome-transfer-learning
desc: Best transfer learning and domain adaptation resources (papers, tutorials, datasets, etc.)

resources.name: NYU Depth Dataset V2
resources.desc: labeled paired images taken with two different cameras (normal and depth)

resources.name: CelebA
resources.desc: faces of celebrities, offering the possibility to perform gender or hair color translation for instance

resources.name: Office-Caltech dataset
resources.desc: images of office objects from 10 common categories shared by the Office-31 and Caltech-256 datasets. There are in total four domains: Amazon, Webcam, DSLR and Caltech.

resources.name: Cityscapes dataset
resources.desc: street scene photos (source) and their annoted version (target)

resources.name: CycleGAN datasets
resources.desc: horse2zebra, apple2orange, cezanne2photo, monet2photo, ukiyoe2photo, vangogh2photo, summer2winter

resources.name: RaFD
resources.desc: facial images with 8 different emotions (anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness, surprise, contempt, and neutral). You can transfer a face from one emotion to another.

resources.name: VisDA 2017 classification dataset
resources.desc: 12 categories of object images in 2 domains: 3D-models and real images.

resources.name: Office-Home dataset
resources.desc: images of objects in 4 domains: art, clipart, product and real-world.

resources.name: Amazon review benchmark dataset
resources.desc: sentiment analysis for four kinds (domains) of reviews: books, DVDs, electronics, kitchen

resources.name: ECML/PKDD Spam Filtering
resources.desc: emails from 3 different inboxes, that can represent the 3 domains.

resources.name: 20 Newsgroup
resources.desc: collection of newsgroup documents across 6 top categories and 20 subcategories. Subcategories can play the role of the domains, as describe in this article.

resources.name: Transfer Learning for Natural Language Processing
